title: She (Ami) light up our life!
text: Ami (short for Amitai) was so sweet and wonderful to work with.  We hired her to take pictures for my nephew’s surprise! engagement pictures.  Not only she took pictures but orchestrated the whole event activities leading up to my nephew’s proposal. It was effortless.  She helped made the surprise proposal memorable and made my nephew, his fiancée, and the rest of my family who was there to witness the proposal very happy and delighted with the whole experience.  We all love her because she helped us enjoy the start of our vacation in Barcelona.
author: Dulce_K
